data.title: App Shell & Canonical Window Layout
data.goalStatement: The foundational macOS app shell implementing the canonical 'Rectify Window': a bezel-less live-mirror region with a side panel exposing exactly three tabs (Notes, Payload, History), plus the toolbar frame and status-bar chrome that every other feature plugs into. Includes the full light/dark theme system with the signal-color palette (red = bug, green = fixed, orange = warning, blue = measurement) and contrast parity in both themes. Why first: all 16 catalog screens import this layout, and every subsequent feature renders inside it, so the shell and theming must exist before any device, annotation or payload work can land.

functionalRequirements.text: Use the canonical 'Rectify Window' layout: a bezel-less live mirror with a side panel exposing exactly three tabs (Notes, Payload, History).

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: All screens support full light and dark theme parity using the defined signal-color system (red = bug, green = fixed, orange = warning, blue = measurement) with sufficient contrast in both themes.
v1 targets macOS only; no Windows/Linux builds.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the canonical window layout is confirmed, then the side panel exposes exactly three tabs: Notes, Payload, History, over a bezel-less mirror.
Given the user toggles light/dark theme, then all screens render correctly in both themes with consistent signal colors (red/green/orange/blue) and no unreadable contrast regions.
